title: MME-CoT: Benchmarking Chain-of-Thought in Large Multimodal Models for Reasoning Quality, Robustness, and Efficiency
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark for evaluating Chain-of-Thought reasoning in Large Multimodal Models across technical and general domains like math, science, logic, and space-time. It does not contain any evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
